description: Sectoral Electricity Consumption (MWh) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset presents the annual electricity consumption in Qatar by sector, including bulk (industrial), domestic, and auxiliary uses. It also includes losses from transmission and distribution, total injected generation, and total electricity generation. The data supports analysis of sectoral energy demand patterns and informs infrastructure planning and energy efficiency initiatives. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are electricity, Consumption, domestic, industrial. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
